query:
*[_type == "ticketType" && active == true && (category == $category || (!defined(category) && $category == "admission"))] | order(order asc){
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    price,
    regularPrice,
    description,
    capacity,
    releasedQuantity,
    earlyBirdCutoff,
    order,
    demo,
    provisional,
    requiresDaySelection,
    category,
    capacityPool,
    headcountPerUnit,
    show,
  }
